protest-01.note: Passage confirmed by a PTI report carried by The Week (Ranchi, 26 Aug 2025, 17:50 IST), headline 'Jharkhand assembly passes resolution against SIR of electoral rolls'. Source moved from News Arena India to that PTI copy. The Speaker ruled the resolution passed because the ruling coalition had a majority, after a Congress member asked for a vote; the claim now says that rather than 'without a vote'.
protest-01.claim: The Week, carrying a PTI report, said the Jharkhand Assembly passed a resolution opposing the SIR, moved by Parliamentary Affairs Minister Radhakrishna Kishore on behalf of the INDIA bloc. The BJP opposed it. When a Congress member asked for a vote, the Speaker ruled that it stood passed because the ruling coalition had a majority.
protest-01.quote: Ranchi, Aug 26 (PTI) A resolution opposing the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls was passed in the Jharkhand assembly on Tuesday. ... Replying to him, the speaker said, "The resolution stands automatically passed as the ruling coalition has a majority in the House."

protest-02.note: PTI copy on Siasat, 29 Sep 2025. Quote word for word. The source confirms the Chief Minister moved the resolution and the Congress-led opposition backed it.

protest-03.note: Quote, date (2 Nov 2025) and claim confirmed: nearly 50 parties attended, the AIADMK and BJP were not invited, and the DMDK, TVK, NTK and PMK stayed away. It was an all-party meeting and not an Assembly resolution, so it moves to protests.

protest-04.note: Quote word for word, 9 Jul 2025. The source reports that Rahul Gandhi joined the march with Tejashwi Yadav.

protest-05.note: PTI copy on Deccan Herald, 21 Jul 2025. Quote word for word. CPI(ML) Liberation members came in black kurtas.

protest-06.note: 28 Jul 2025. Quote word for word. The protest at the Makar Dwar was on the fifth consecutive day, and the MPs demanded a rollback.

protest-07.note: The Wire, 11 Aug 2025. Quote word for word. The MPs were released in the afternoon. The Commission's letter to Jairam Ramesh asking for 30 names 'due to limitation of space' is in the source.

protest-08.note: 17 Aug 2025. Quote word for word. 16-day yatra ending in Patna on 1 September. Rahul Gandhi's words 'SIR is being done in Bihar to steal votes' support the attributed allegation.

protest-09.note: Quote and date (4 Nov 2025) confirmed. The source does not say the procession was on the day enumeration began, so that is removed. Her words were 'an assault on people's existence and democratic rights'.
protest-09.claim: ETV Bharat reported that Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee led a procession in Kolkata against the SIR. She called the SIR an assault on people's existence and democratic rights.

protest-10.note: Akashvani, 11 Nov 2025. Quote word for word. The source says Members of Parliament, State Assembly members and district functionaries took part.

protest-11.note: Quote, claim and response confirmed. The Tribune's story is dated 02:00 AM 26 Nov 2025 IST; the march was on Tuesday 25 November. Date set to the publication date.

protest-12.note: PTI copy on Siasat, 30 Jan 2026. Quote and response confirmed. The source says Gogoi accused Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma, not the state government, of misusing the Election Commission.
protest-12.claim: The Siasat Daily, carrying a PTI report, said the united opposition held a protest at Chachal in Guwahati against alleged irregularities in the draft rolls of Assam's Special Revision. Assam Congress president Gaurav Gogoi accused Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma of misusing the Election Commission.

protest-13.note: 7 Feb 2026. Quote word for word. Trade unions, women's groups, student bodies and Dalit and minority rights groups took part under the banner 'My Vote, My Right', urging the Karnataka government to take a clear stand.

protest-14.note: 10 Mar 2026. Quote word for word. The Supreme Court ordered appellate tribunals headed by former High Court judges.

protest-15.note: 20 Aug 2026. Quote word for word. The delegation including Kumari Selja alleged it was not allowed into the premises.

protest-16.note: Business Today, 25 Sep 2026. Quote and response word for word in substance; the Commission 'rejected the characterisation of these exchanges as institutional dissent and maintained that final decisions on SIR were unanimous'.

protest-17.note: Same Business Today report, 25 Sep 2026. Quote word for word.

protest-18.note: Date, outlet and claim confirmed (Dipankar Bhattacharya, a party general secretary, was detained). The quote named the president of the All India Students' Association, a student leader and a private person; that name is trimmed. Yogendra Yadav and Prashant Bhushan are kept as public figures.
protest-18.quote: Several civil society groups, the All India Students’ Association ... Swaraj Party leader Yogendra Yadav, and activist Prashant Bhushan held a protest at Jantar Mantar to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and a rollback of the SIR exercise.

protest-19.note: PTI copy on ThePrint, 25 Sep 2026. Quote word for word. Police detained Ajay Rai, the CLP leader and hundreds of workers.

protest-20.note: Quote, date and response confirmed. The ThePrint story is auto-generated from ANI, not ThePrint's own reporting; outlet and attribution corrected. The source says the protests were part of the Congress's nationwide programme on the Commission's handling of the SIR.
protest-20.claim: ThePrint, carrying an ANI report, said police used water cannons on Congress workers in Patna who were protesting against the Chief Election Commissioner as part of the party's nationwide programme over the SIR.
protest-20.response: The report said the Commission described operational queries and internal feedback as part of the normal functioning of a multi-member body and said all final SIR decisions were unanimous.

protest-21.note: Quote and date confirmed. Same ANI copy on ThePrint; outlet and attribution corrected.
protest-21.claim: ThePrint, carrying an ANI report, said police used water cannons on Punjab Congress workers demonstrating in Chandigarh as part of the party's protests over the SIR.

protest-22.note: PTI copy on ThePrint, 25 Sep 2026. Quote word for word.

protest-23.note: UNI, 25 Sep 2026 (only the first 101 words are free; the quote and the march led by Vincent H Pala are within them). Quote word for word.

protest-24.note: Quote and claim confirmed (the party raised the adding and deleting of names and the disposal of objections). The story is dated 01:00 IST on 26 Sep 2026. Date set to the publication date.

protest-25.note: PTI copy on ThePrint, 26 Sep 2026. Quote and response word for word. The source names D K Shivakumar as Chief Minister and Siddaramaiah as a former Chief Minister.

protest-26.note: PTI copy on ThePrint, 28 Sep 2026. Quote word for word. Police used water cannons, and Gehlot, Dotasra and Randhawa were detained.

protest-27.note: The source never mentions the SIR, only the demand for the Chief Election Commissioner's resignation, so it is outside this page.
protest-27.quote: Earlier in the day, speaking at a protest organised by the CJP at Shivaji Park in Mumbai, ... had warned of “Jantar Mantar 2.0” if Kumar did not step down.

protest-28.note: The South First, 3 Oct 2026. Quote word for word. More than a dozen groups co-organised; demands were scrapping the SIR and the CEC's resignation.

protest-29.note: Quote and date confirmed. The source has both leaders seeking the CEC's resignation, but only Raj Thackeray is reported demanding the SIR be cancelled.
protest-29.claim: The Free Press Journal reported that Uddhav Thackeray of the Shiv Sena (UBT) and Raj Thackeray of the MNS led the Virat Garjana Morcha in Mumbai seeking the Chief Election Commissioner's resignation. Raj Thackeray demanded that the SIR in Maharashtra be cancelled.

protest-30.note: The Wire, dated 6 Oct 2026. Quote word for word. Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra were detained at the sit-in at the All India Radio building.

protest-31.note: PTI copy on Deccan Herald, 7 Oct 2026. Quote word for word. AAP protested earlier at Jantar Mantar (2 Oct) and India Gate (4 Oct).

protest-32.note: Quote and claim confirmed, including the detention of Devender Yadav at Jantar Mantar. The Tribune story is dated 05:16 AM 8 Oct 2026 IST; the march was on Wednesday 7 October. Date set to the publication date.

protest-33.note: The News Minute, 17 Nov 2025. Quote word for word; the source itself says 'allegedly due' and the claim attributes no cause. The CEO's statement on complaints is in the source. No BLO is named in the quote or claim.

protest-34.note: PTI copy on Deccan Herald, 18 Nov 2025. Quote word for word.

protest-35.note: PTI copy on Deccan Herald, 24 Nov 2025. Quote word for word. The BLO Adhikar Raksha Committee march and the CEO's 'real heroes' remark are in the source.

protest-36.note: Quote and claim confirmed (The Wire, drawing on The Indian Express). The Wire's datePublished is 28 Nov 2025 09:28 IST; the sit-in was on Thursday 27 November. Date set to the publication date.

protest-37.note: Amar Ujala, published 2 Dec 2025. Quote word for word. The source names the Uttar Pradeshiya Prathmik Shikshak Sangh (Pandey faction) and the demand for government jobs and compensation for families. No private person is named in the quote.

protest-38.note: The Wire page fetched; published 30 Sept 2026 23:03, meeting on Wednesday 30 September, headline matches. Quote verbatim. 33 leaders from 19 parties, the district marches 2 to 8 October, the MPs' march on 6 October, the meeting with the President, five rallies including Delhi on 1 November all in the report; Kharge's 'puppet' remark is attributed to him as reported.

protest-39.note: Deccan Herald page fetched; published 7 Oct 2026 00:01 about Tuesday 6 October, og headline matches. Quote verbatim, joined across paragraph breaks and the source's own '...' elisions. The march to Nirvachan Sadan seeking the CEC's removal and the demand for 240 MPs to meet the CEC and two ECs at Parliament House Annexe are in the report. Response matches the EC statement; Asianet Newsable (ANI, 6 Oct 22:00) carries the fuller statement and agrees.
